Remove singleton sample dimensions.

| | |

| Status | Runs |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Input** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Tensor containing one or more size-one dimensions |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Output** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Tensor with selected singleton dimensions removed |

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Shape | Dimension | `dim` | Integer | `-1` |   | The run | Dimension to remove, or -1 to remove all singleton dimensions. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | No: Squeeze is a tensor graph utility node; PipelineExecutor tensor shape execution is not implemented |
| Training (the compiled model) | Yes, as a layer of the model: compiled and built as a resolved singleton-dimension removal layer |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.

## Usage

```text
squeeze(dim) removes specific dim, squeeze() removes all size-1 dims.
```

## Tips

- Useful after operations that add singleton dims.
- Common after pooling to remove spatial dims.
